quest.title: Over the Moon
quest.description: Kujirai Momiji invites you all over. She seems to have come to some conclusion...
quest.rewards_formatted: Moonstringer x1, Glowgrass Bait x20, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: There you are, sorry to bother you again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You look well.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Haha, thanks for the compliment. I kind of thought it through.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Perhaps, some things just can't be forced.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Can you accompany me to the western beach tonight? I have something for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, is it some kind of sea treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: You'll see.

talks.objective: Go to the beach that Kujirai Momiji mentioned at night

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: We're here. This is where my father went to sea for the last time that year. It was a night like this too, and I never saw him again after that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You miss him a lot, don't you? Is your wish to see your father again?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Haha, I do miss him, but the people of the sea will have to return to the sea one day.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: But my wish is to become a fisherman who surpasses my father.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: When I was young, I always wanted to sail with my father, but he would only let my mother take me back. He sometimes even took the neighbor's son, and was not willing to take me.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: He always said, "Momiji, don't hang around on the beach, go do something girls should do." Or he would say, "Take the money and buy a dress, don't run to the boat all the time." ...

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: But I didn't understand. Why? What are things that girls should do?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: I can buy candy, pick flowers, and be a little princess.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: But can't I go on an adventure, go far out to sea, or explore the ocean?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: The more my father didn't want me to do it, the more I wanted to. After my father left, I became a fisherman.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Those seas he couldn't explore, I'll explore then. Those large fishes he couldn't catch, I'll catch them.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: I will inherit the fishing methods of the Kujirai family. I will carry on the name of the Kujirai family of fishermen.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Even if the legend of the "Lunar Leviathan" is just a legend, I won't stop there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I believe you will succeed.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Since the divine fish is not here, I will pour my wishes into the sea. I think my father will see it.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Do you have any wishes? Let's do this together, write down your wishes, stuff them into a drifting bottle, and throw it out with all your might. They will come true one day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow— Does this really work?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon has so many wishes, which one to write... Paimon's so torn!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Sorry for bothering you during this time! I don't even know how to thank you. Here are some gifts, I hope you don't mind...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow— Look, what's that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a big school of fish! They're glowing, they seem to like our drifting bottles!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When these guys gather together, it's like a big moon in the sea!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: These...these fish, they are "Moonfins"...

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Oh! I know...I know! So this is the "Lunar Leviathan!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? This is the "Lunar Leviathan?"

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: That's right, I would never forget the way it looked. Its starry moonlit dots...That year that "Lunar Leviathan" also appeared under Jiawei when he dropped the drift bottle.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: No wonder, after all these years, no one's been really able to catch the "Lunar Leviathan!"

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Because it turns out, it is just composed of a school of "Moonfins."

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Those "Moonfins"...Who would have thought they would like an ordinary drifting bottle?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, maybe they like the wishes that people pour into the bottles.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Haha! Perhaps, well then watch me Kujirai Momiji catch them all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We want to come too! Let us help!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: In that case, allow me to give you this fishing rod. It was specially made by the Kujirai family in pursuit of the "Lunar Leviathan".

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Although it is far from being able to express my gratitude to you, but it is a small token of my appreciation.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Let's use it to catch all the "Moonfins"!
